definition: If a task has stages, with $m$ ways to do the first and $n$ ways to do the second whatever the first choice was, the whole task can be done in $m \times n$ ways.
If a task is done in one of two separate cases that cannot both happen, with $m$ ways and $n$ ways, there are $m + n$ ways in total.
An arrangement of $r$ objects chosen from $n$ different objects, where the order matters; there are ${}^{n}P_{r}$ of them.
A selection of $r$ objects from $n$ different objects, where the order does not matter; there are ${}^{n}C_{r}$ of them.
